normal.content: Publish one post from your Nextdoor Business Page (Marketing agent has posts ready to copy).
normal.acquisition: Pin flyers at 2 places with a public board (laundromat, library). Ask first.
normal.followup: Reply to every New Lead. Then clear anything on 'Follow-ups due'.
normal.optional: Take 5 minutes of close-up photos or video on your next job for later posts.

normal.content: No post today. Check your Nextdoor page: hours, prices and photos are correct.
normal.acquisition: Answer every Nextdoor message within the hour if you can. Add each one as a lead (source: nextdoor).
normal.followup: Send any 'no reply - first nudge' messages that are due.
normal.optional: Look at one nearby detailer's prices so you know where you stand.

normal.content: Publish one Nextdoor Business Page post (a before/after if you have one).
normal.acquisition: Check Nextdoor Groups you've joined: only post the business where the group's rules allow it.
normal.optional: Drop 5-10 flyers at one more public board.

normal.acquisition: Visit ONE local business in person (tire shop, repair shop, used-car lot) with flyers. Use the partner intro template. Record it in Prospecting.
normal.followup: Check every Quote Sent lead - send the quote follow-up if it's been 2+ days.
normal.optional: Add your real open drop-off times for next week on the Book tab.

normal.content: If you have REAL open slots, post 'Open drop-off times this week' on Nextdoor with those exact times.
normal.acquisition: Text past customers whose repeat date has arrived (repeat offer template). Only people who've done business with you.
normal.optional: Ask one happy customer to Fave you on Nextdoor.

normal.content: Use the Work tab on every car. Take before/after photos at the same spots.
normal.acquisition: Ask today's customers if it's okay to post photos of their car (plate blurred), and to Fave you on Nextdoor.
normal.followup: Review / Fave requests for yesterday's completed jobs.
normal.optional: Read your Work tab 'biggest time sink' and focus on it next job.

normal.content: No posting required. Read this week's Marketing agent brief.
normal.acquisition: Open the Weekly report. Do more of what brought inquiries; drop what took time and brought nothing.
normal.followup: Mark anyone who hasn't replied after 2 follow-ups as Lost. Save a backup file (More > Setup).
normal.optional: Log any marketing time you forgot to record this week.

cash_mode: 1. Reply to every New Lead right now. Speed wins most small jobs.
2. Send every follow-up due today (quote follow-ups first - they already know the price).
3. Add your REAL open drop-off slots for the next 7 days on the Book tab.
4. Text past customers whose repeat date is close (repeat offer template) - only people who've done business with you.
5. Ask 2-3 happy past customers for a referral and a Nextdoor Fave.
6. Post 'Open drop-off times this week' with your real open slots from your Nextdoor Business Page.
7. Walk 15 flyers to tire shops, laundromats and the library today. Ask before pinning.
8. Skip anything that doesn't lead to a message today.
